profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, ticker COUR, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its site describes an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with content from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. The company describes its certificates as providing job-ready skills and a verifiable credential, and it markets Coursera Plus as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The site names programs in AI, data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering, including the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Essentials Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. It also points to beginner-friendly Python and generative AI courses and to browsing areas such as artificial intelligence, SQL, and web development.

The company's record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. It is recorded as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001651562, and California is listed as a jurisdiction with 281 cases.
